Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a two-vehicle collision in Pearland, Texas, involving a left turn at an intersection. Driver 1 was
turning left when the front of their vehicle was struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the
intersection. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred just as they described it, and independent witnesses at the
scene gave consistent accounts. Scene photographs show damage concentrated at the front of Driver 1's vehicle and
the driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle, which is consistent with the reported impact. Driver 1 reported a concussion and
was evaluated at the scene. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, and both officers and witnesses confirmed
their presence. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the insured party on
the coverage documents presented at the scene. Both drivers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the
time of the report.
</page>
